verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a defined model lifecycle from release to retirement, intended for choosing production models and planning migrations. It also publishes per-release model cards and a List/Retrieve Models endpoint, which implies discrete model releases that a developer could target. None of the evidence mentions versioned model IDs, aliases, or how aliases map to versions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exact versioned model IDs, alias identifiers that track the latest release, a documented alias-to-version update policy, and independent corroboration.
